(async()=>{const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {listAssistantFiles,getAssistantFile,attachmentImagePreview}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/attachmentFiles.ts');const {assistantTurn}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/transport.ts');const project=useStudio.getState().job.id;const files=(await listAssistantFiles(project)).filter(f=>f.name.endsWith('.png')).slice(0,20);const parts=[{text:'These are 20 QA swatch images. Describe their colour in one sentence.'}];for(const f of files){const {blob}=await getAssistantFile(project,f.id);parts.push({inlineData:await attachmentImagePreview(blob)})}if(parts.length!==21)throw Error('Wrong image count');const response=await assistantTurn({schema:'xray.assistant-request/v1',requestId:crypto.randomUUID(),contents:[{role:'user',parts}],declarations:[],webSearch:false},new AbortController().signal);return {images:20,requestCharacters:JSON.stringify(parts).length,model:response.model,text:response.content.parts.filter(p=>!p.thought).map(p=>p.text).join(' ')}})()
